title: Routing in Line Networks with Handling Times
summary: Motivated by hyperconnected urban parcel networks for same-day and time-sensitive delivery, we study the fixed-line routing problem that arises when evaluating a candidate set of recurring inter-hub vehicle services. Vehicles follow predefined cyclic sequences of service points, or lines, and parcels may transfer between lines. Such transfers expand path choice but require loading and unloading operations that make vehicles dwell at service points.
